description: Check up to 12 references (one per line, blank-line separated, BibTeX, or an array of strings) against arXiv, Crossref and DBLP. Each gets verified / verified_with_issues / partial_match / not_found, the problem (fabricated reference, DOI of a different paper, wrong year, wrong first author, garbled title, missing DOI), the canonical record and a corrected APA + BibTeX entry. Use it before you publish anything an AI helped write. Needs a Quill Research Pass (1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days, 15 USDC = 30 days by plain USDC transfer on Base; see payment_options), or pay per call over HTTP x402 ($0.05) at /v1/refcheck.

pass.description: Optional Quill Research Pass token (qp1...). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

refs.description: Reference list: one per line or blank-line separated, or BibTeX entries. Up to 12 references, 9000 characters. Omit for a demo. A string (one reference per line or blank-line separated, or BibTeX) or an array of strings.

name: check_references
